# Inpatient Clinical Note

> A structured clinical note written about an **admitted patient during a hospital episode**. Unlike a single bedside ward-round entry, one inpatient clinical note can be any of the note types a ward team produces across an admission — admission clerking, daily progress note, specialty consult note, acute event / deterioration note, bedside procedure note, shift handover note, inter-ward transfer note, or discharge-planning note — all keyed to the same admission episode and sharing one data shape.
